content: PubSubClient default MQTT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE=256B, configurable up to 65536B via setBufferSize(); keep messages <1KB in practice to avoid ESP32 memory fragmentation. AsyncMqttClient (marvinroger) is unmaintained since 2021 with known reliability issues (crashes on large inbound packets, weak QoS1/2 recovery); ESP32Async org maintains active forks of AsyncTCP/ESPAsyncWebServer for current cores. For this project's synchronous, low-connection-churn use case, PubSubClient (already used in gateway-esp32-wifi env) remains the pragmatic choice.
